sourceCounts.sourceBackbone: Template:StructureNav has 91 location/structure cards before exclusions and pruning: 74 non-event/non-exclusive/non-removed rows, 7 event rows, 4 exclusive rows, and 6 removed rows.
sourceCounts.pondRowsChecked: Locations table has 6 pond rows; Frog Pond/Frog Cave Portal is excluded as Frog Invasion event content, leaving 5 pond rows.

blockers: No shared route/config edits were made by this subagent, so rendered card count and field rendering still need parent-owned integration.
A few kept rows intentionally avoid exact loot, chest, entity, or requirement claims because checked sources only support the location/category, not a row-level pool.
No blank-image rows remain after pruning Snowy Post Fence and resolving source imageinfo URLs.
notes: No coordinates are stored because the run map is procedurally generated and sources do not support fixed coordinates for these rows.
Chest counts and exact loot are only used where source rows explicitly list them. Otherwise row loot stays cautious and source-aware.
Biomes are not standalone item rows; they appear only in biomeGroup and biome fields.
Temporary event, exclusive, removed, and weak landmark/prop source buckets are excluded or pruned from the main item list to avoid stale-guide and filler rows.

items.name: Medium Cabin
items.notableLoot: Fuel, scrap, special loot, Mossy Coins, and a chest listed on its individual source page.

items.routeTip: Collect chairs for log value when safe; the source notes Medium Cabin can help get upgrades faster early on.

items.name: Large Cabin
